## Purpose
The purpose profiles: tool and activity strategies behind one interface.

## Responsibilities
- `_PROFILES = {"tool": ToolProfile(), "activity": ActivityProfile()}`.
- `get_profile(purpose)` falls back to tool.
- Re-exports CodeProfile, ToolProfile, ActivityProfile, ReviewDecision, RuntimePolicy and get_profile.
